answer: Garden commit-reveal bond: each identity seals its garden plan in basalt at horizon's start. It stakes 70 credits, tends the plot, then reveals at horizon's end; auditors match garden to plan, and a mismatch or no reveal burns the stake. Each extra identity adds 7 to a 45 filing fee, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,541,500, lock 70,000, and gain at most 40 each. One hash, one reveal: no rented-garden ring reuses one plot. Honest ones pay 45 once, keep it.
